B2B / B2C / SELECTED PROJECT

Snooker Management

A management platform bringing table bookings, players, and tournaments into one interface.

MY ROLE

UI/UX design

PROJECT SCOPE

Web management platform

FOCUS

B2B/B2C · Booking & dashboards

The challenge.

Club operations and consumer bookings involve different tasks, from table availability to player management and tournament organization.

The approach.

I designed a web-based management system for business and consumer users, organizing booking, player management, tournaments, and real-time updates into understandable interfaces.

Design decisions.

  • Create intuitive table-booking interfaces.
  • Organize player management and tournament activities.
  • Make real-time operational updates easy to scan.
  • Support both business and consumer workflows.
